description.value: A private campground beside the White River near Sayward on northern Vancouver Island, with tent sites in an open meadow along the riverbank; flush toilets, showers, and power hookups add comfort, and kayakers can launch directly to the Salmon River and Kelsey Bay.

address.value: White River Resort, 1673 Sayward Rd, Sayward, BC V0P 1R0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content from saywardwhiteriverresort.com is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM phone number, email, and business name. The site describes tenting sites with 15/30 amp power and water taps at each site, coin-operated showers, and WiFi at all sites, providing strong positive evidence for several amenities. Reservations are explicitly invited via email with a deposit required for cabins, confirming that amenity as well.
concerns: No physical address provided in OSM or on the website; location must be inferred from coordinates near Sayward, BC.
OSM includes a German name variant (name:de=White River Campground) that differs slightly from the primary registered name; not a substantive concern.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, established campground near Sayward with tenting sites, showers, potable water, and river access — a viable overnight stop for touring cyclists on northern Vancouver Island.

wow_evidence: tenting sites with 15/30 amp power and water taps at each site, coin-operated showers
